movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Clapping hands rhythmically in time with the music.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers move in a circle facing inward.

signature_moves.description: Dancers clap hands rhythmically while moving in a circle.
signature_moves.name: Circle Clapping

signature_moves.description: Dancers unable to keep pace step out as tempo accelerates.
signature_moves.name: Removal Step

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts moderate and progressively accelerates to a fast pace.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid attempting fast-paced removal steps without practice to prevent falls.

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response between lead singer and chorus.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Progressively accelerating rhythm with dynamic tempo increases.
music_profile.sound_description: The music features rhythmic drum beats from the mirdanga and sharp clashing sounds from the kartals, supporting a lead vocalist whose devotional songs are echoed by a chorus of women, building in tempo and intensity.
music_profile.vocal_style: Lead singer followed by chorus singing devotional songs about Radha and Krishna.

basic_steps: Form a circle with other dancers.
Begin clapping hands rhythmically in time with the music.
Follow the lead singer's vocal cues.
Increase movement speed as tempo accelerates.
Step out when unable to keep pace as dancers are removed.
teaching.formation: Circle formation with participants facing inward.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with steady clapping and simple circular movement; intermediate dancers increase speed and endurance; advanced dancers maintain pace as tempo peaks.
teaching.rhythm: Progressively accelerating rhythm driven by mirdanga and kartals.
